verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser is documented only as a managed cloud browser service ('managed cloud sessions', 'no infrastructure management required'), and nothing in the evidence describes self-hosting its core browser infrastructure. The open-source HyperAgent framework is an adjacent Playwright add-on, not a self-hostable version of the core product, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
